headline: A 2012 executive order aimed at speeding up investment in energy efficiency at factories and other industrial sites.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to encourage more investment in making industrial facilities use energy more efficiently. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies involved, and any targets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are the likely focus of federal efforts to encourage investment in energy-saving upgrades.
They are likely directed to take steps that promote industrial energy efficiency investment.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 30, 2012; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
